evidence.locator: text: paragraphs 1-2 and 4 (the subject is specifically GMV's patterns and generating sh script; the bespoke terms retain the complete copyright notice and prescribe modification comments plus generated-output labeling rather than using a standard software-license grant)

text: paragraph 4 and complete-text review (changes require explanatory comments and, for the generating script, clear labels on generated output, but no same-license, source-disclosure, or reciprocal licensing condition is stated)

text: paragraphs 2 and 4 ('spreading these patterns' is expected, the software may be used 'for any purpose', and changes are expressly contemplated); together these support commercial and private use, distribution, and modification, while no sublicensing or patent grant is express

text: paragraph 4 (the complete COPYRIGHT NOTICE may not be deleted; changes must carry comments identifying who changed the software, when, and why; a changed generating script must contain code that clearly labels every output as generated by a modified script); include-copyright, include-license-text, and mark-modifications capture the general duties, while the script-code/output-label mechanism has no exact vocabulary term and is represented by unknown; requests to send changes and problem reports are nonbinding

text: paragraphs 3-4 (modification activates the change-comment duty and modifying the generating script activates the output-labeling duty; use itself constitutes acceptance and the copyright notice may never be deleted, but the vocabulary has no use/possession trigger, represented by unknown; no linking, combination, network-use, or patent-claim trigger is stated)

text: paragraph 3 (the software is provided without any warranty and Julio Sanchez, GMV, Jose A. Manas, and their agents or representatives disclaim responsibility for software errors and damages derived from use, including after notice of possible damages); complete-text review finds no trademark, patent-claim, or additional-terms restriction
text: complete COPYRIGHT NOTICE (no patent grant, patent covenant, patent condition, or patent-claim termination is stated)

text: paragraph 4 (the complete copyright notice is immutable, every change needs who/when/why comments, and a modified generating script must be coded so every output is clearly labeled as generated by a modified script); the multiple artifact-specific marking duties create a material burden

metadata: id=Bahyph, name='Bahyph License', deprecated=false, osi=false, fsf=false; text: paragraphs 1-4 apply bespoke terms to hyphenation patterns and their generating sh script, make use an acceptance trigger, and impose script/output-specific modification labeling that vocabulary 1.0.0 cannot represent losslessly, so this non-OSI domain license is not a safe general recommendation for the software-oriented guide
